{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
test_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
num_test_orders = len(test_orders)

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders
completed_orders = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].sum()

# Print all necessary values
num_test_orders, total_revenue"}
